body:
Large companies are becoming leaner, AI is automating layers of work that used to require headcount, and a growing share of opportunity is concentrating inside small, high-leverage teams, i.e. startups.

Most business programs was built for the old version of this economy: one with stable hierarchies, predictable career ladders, and large organizations hiring in bulk. 

Mesa was built for the version that's emerging. A curriculum centered on real business-building, founder collaboration, and the skills that actually matter when companies are small and execution is everything; launching products, understanding customers, generating revenue, and making decisions without a playbook. 

Cohort 2028 applications are open. Explore the program.
headline: The next decade belongs to builders
